attempts.summary: On node1, deployed a rootless OCI container (runc, sharing the host network namespace) running BusyBox httpd on port 8080, entirely under the unprivileged appsvc system user. The container is managed by an appsvc systemd --user unit (webapp.service, enabled), and loginctl enable-linger appsvc makes systemd start appsvc's user manager (and the enabled unit) at boot even with zero active login sessions for that account. Verified across a full node reboot: boot ID changed, no appsvc login session exists, user@999.service and webapp.service are active, and HTTP 8080 serves correctly post-restart.
